It also reads as distinct from the recently overused Current Vivid Flyer and Cut-Paper Collage treatments and adapts cleanly to a square social carousel.

Photography-led, editorial layout best carries the campaign’s cinematic ‘countdown to midnight’ moment while leaving generous space for the four-card headlines and the longer primary copy. It reads as an elegant, destination-forward celebration (truthful to the NYE sailing offer) without leaning into gimmicky party graphics, and it’s well suited to a square social carousel. Also distinct from the heavily repeated “current_vivid_flyer” and recently used “cut_paper_collage.”
